[Verse 1]
[Em]Four seasons [D/F#]in one day
[G][Am]Lying in the depths
[Am6]of your imagination

[G]The [Am]sun shines on the black
[Am6]clouds Hanging over the do-
[C/G]main

[Am][Am6]Like
[D]four seasons in one day
[G]  [D/F#]

[Verse 2]
[Em]Smiling as the [D/F#]shit comes down
[G][Am]You can tell a man
[Am6]from what he has to say
[Em]Everything gets [D/F#]turned around
[G]And [Am]I will risk my
[Am6]neck again, again
[C/G]

[C/G]

[Am][Am6]Like
